Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature" [notes inscription 1, but not date]. Backing inscriptions date 1937 and 1936. Dated 1936 on basis of inclusion in 1937 New York (An American Place – O'Keeffe) exhibition and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. See cat. nos. 904–6, 1999. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
